affected_predicate.description: A text message containing the exact requested interview schedule is sent to Kevin.

competing_trace_defects.description: Before the reuse target, an attempted Kevin search produced no visible filtering, after which repeated scrolling, repeated text entry, and Enter submissions continued without selecting Kevin or opening a message composer.

chains.rationale: At the reuse target, the agent explicitly relies on the inherited premise that further scrolling will reveal a K section and performs another drag. The remaining observable steps stay within the same ineffective contact-acquisition process: another Kevin input followed by repeated clicks on the top-right keyboard/search control. No Kevin recipient is selected, no conversation composer appears, and the requested message is never visibly entered or sent. The target therefore continues the already active loop, and no later step visibly corrects it.

summary: The single strict-MHR reuse target visibly continues an existing ineffective Kevin-contact search loop. Through the last observable step, no recipient is selected and no requested interview message is composed or sent.
